cohort: 16,182 women who underwent hysterectomy for benign indications in Sweden between 2006 and 2013
finding: Vaginal delivery, obesity, and daily urge symptoms without incontinence prior to surgery increased the risk of de novo urinary incontinence and decreased the rate of remission of urinary incontinence after hysterectomy, which negatively impacted patient satisfaction.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery increased the risk of de novo urinary incontinence and decreased the rate of remission of urinary incontinence after hysterectomy.
